skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basics of architecture, including requirements, concepts, and basic design research and analysis methods for construction projects, types of architectural projects, and the ability to read and analyze architectural design drawings, and apply them in real estate services and business.
Understand the basics of design and planning, including residential, public, and industrial architecture, and the ability to analyze and evaluate architectural design drawings.
Understand the principles and quality assessment of urban planning, and the ability to analyze and evaluate urban planning design drawings.
Develop communication skills, teamwork, decision-making, and project management skills.
Understand and have the ability to read and use tools to support the basic content of architectural design drawings, and the ability to analyze and evaluate architectural design drawings.

Understand the social role and responsibility of architectural projects, enhance a sense of responsibility, perseverance, professionalism, and cooperation in solving emerging issues, and have the ability to think independently and adapt to the context and take responsibility.
